## Pull request overview

Updates the Console app and `@object-ui/auth` documentation to consistently target the versioned auth API path (`/api/v1/auth`), fixing runtime 404s when fetching sessions against Cloud backends.

**Changes:**
- Updated Console runtime configuration to use `authUrl="/api/v1/auth"`.
- Aligned `@object-ui/auth` JSDoc examples to reference `/api/v1/auth`.
- Updated `packages/auth/README.md` preview-mode example to use `/api/v1/auth`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/auth/src/types.ts | Updates config JSDoc example to show `/api/v1/auth` as the auth base URL. |
| packages/auth/src/createAuthenticatedFetch.ts | Updates JSDoc example to use `createAuthClient({ baseURL: '/api/v1/auth' })`. |
| packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts | Updates JSDoc example to use `baseURL: '/api/v1/auth'`. |
| packages/auth/src/AuthProvider.tsx | Updates JSDoc examples to pass `authUrl="/api/v1/auth"`. |
| packages/auth/README.md | Updates preview-mode example to use `/api/v1/auth`. |
| apps/console/src/App.tsx | Fixes Console runtime auth base path to `/api/v1/auth`. |
</details>
